title: How to Install a Kitchen Sink: Basket Strainer, Disposer, and PVC Drain Assembly
summary: This Old House presents a concise, hands-on kitchen-sink installation workflow focused on common residential practices: disconnecting existing water and waste lines, pre-assembling components in a tight cabinet space, installing a basket strainer with plumber’s putty, assembling and securing a garbage disposer with flange and snap-ring hardware, seating and aligning the sink, making electrical connections for the disposer, attaching faucet lines with a basin wrench, dry-fitting and gluing PVC drain piping, and finally restoring water to test the installation.
topics: plumbers putty seal between sink and strainer
seal with putty around disposer flange
batting order rings and snap ring
seat and align sink in opening

sections.title: Sink removal and initial prep
sections.description: Disconnector explains that water and waste lines are disconnected and prepares to push the sink up and out; notes preference for pre-assembly when space is limited.

sections.title: Basket strainer installation and sealant
sections.description: Basket strainer is installed with a small amount of plumbers putty applied for a seal between sink and strainer, with additional putty applied for insurance.

sections.title: Garbage disposer flange assembly
sections.description: Putty is applied on the disposer flange and it is pushed through from the underside, followed by installing a batting-order of rings and a snap ring before tightening the mounting screws.

sections.title: Sink placement and alignment in opening
sections.description: Sink is positioned into the opening; an assistant holds it while the installer goes underneath to guide and align, ensuring the sink sits squarely.

sections.title: Disposer electrical preparation
sections.description: Notes readiness to make electrical connections for the disposer and mentions securing with a wire nut.

sections.title: Faucet connections with basin wrench
sections.description: Describes making hot and cold faucet connections and highlights the basin wrench as a crucial tool for confined spaces.

sections.title: PVC drain dry-fit and glue
sections.description: Performs a dry-fit of new PVC drain lines and proceeds to glue the joints for final assembly.

sections.title: Restore water and test
sections.description: Turns the water back on to verify the completed sink installation and connections.
